nodes.meaning: Immutable mechanism-observed evidence that one ARE-governed Codex turn completed, bound to exact thread, turn, construction, C19 attempt, request-context, and evidence-manifest identities.
Exact immutable C19 bounded-attempt bytes evaluated for the same construction continuation.
ARE result whose kind is complete, direct, gate, or block and whose digest binds the proposed successor semantics.
C19 result whose decision is CONTINUE, STOP, READY_FOR_HUMAN_TEST, or REQUEST_TERMINAL_CONFIRMATION and whose next action may name the first pending D65 stage.
The first applicable pending stage in C19's ordered D65 program, named identically by the ARE direct directive before a successor may be proposed.
Deterministic no-effect conjunction result: direct only for exact dual agreement; otherwise the more restrictive parent boundary.
Human-test readiness produces no successor, while terminal confirmation remains a separate owner decision over an immutable passing packet.

Automatic continuation requires the ARE decision to match the exact completed thread and turn, the C19 evaluation to match its exact construction attempt, C19 CONTINUE, ARE direct, exact next-stage identity equality, intact input digests, and no parent effect authority.
Every result has authority_effect none and effect_authorized false; a direct result is only a proposal for a separately governed successor.

invariants.expression: direct iff are.thread_id == turn.thread_id and are.turn_id == turn.turn_id and c19.attempt_id == turn.attempt_id and c19.decision == CONTINUE and are.kind == direct and c19.next_stage == are.next_stage == exact_first_pending_stage
any absent, malformed, stale, or unequal stage identity yields block
READY_FOR_HUMAN_TEST yields human-test-ready; REQUEST_TERMINAL_CONFIRMATION yields terminal-gate; neither starts a successor
authority_effect == none and effect_authorized == false for every result

claim_limit: Capability-local candidate meaning only; no adoption, ontology or DomainSpec admission, accepted implementation, activation, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
